Package org.apache.juneau.console.views.markdown

package org.apache.juneau.console.views.markdown
An optional markdown-to-HTML rendering story for the views/console toolkit.

The framework itself renders data tables (juneau-console-views) and chrome (juneau-console); neither has any concept of a rendered document. This optional module fills that gap with a single, library-neutral extension point — MarkdownRenderer — plus a shipped default (CommonmarkMarkdownRenderer) that wraps commonmark-java with the GFM tables extension enabled. Because it is a separate module, consumers that do not need markdown pay nothing for it.

The rendered HTML is meant to be dropped inside a .jc-prose container so it inherits the console's prose typography. Wiring the rendered output into a Tab/Subtab panel's content property is a deferred follow-on integration point, not part of this module.
